name: ui-design
description: Mock a UI before it is built and let the human decide: 2-4 real options per decision, served on a local decision hub, audited for contrast and accessibility in both themes, with test ids and optional i18n, and the pick recorded in the page. Standalone; other skills may call it.

interface.shortDescription: Mock UI options and let the human pick, with accessibility, i18n and test ids built in.
interface.longDescription: UI Design mocks a screen or component before implementation as 2-4 genuinely different options at the target's real size, on one page with tabs, a light and dark theme and an optional language toggle. A built-in audit (WCAG contrast, real semantics, target size, input purpose, data-testid on every control, i18n coverage, and axe-core) must pass in every theme and language before the page is shown. The human picks, favorites or annotates on a local decision hub and the answer comes straight back to the agent; the final pick is recorded in the page so later work can find it by tag. Requires bash, jq, git and socat.
defaultPrompt: Mock three options for the settings screen and let me pick.
Turn off UI questions, I'm going AFK.
